subject: Error in AICc.unmarkedFit(X[[1L]], ...) :  High overdispersion and model fit is questionable

messages.author: 6e7728addc65d294
messages.subject: Error in AICc.unmarkedFit(X[[1L]], ...) :  High overdispersion and model fit is questionable
parts:
I am doing an occupancy project about prey species (5 species) in Cambodia. I am using unmarked and AICcmodavg packages.

I am trying to average my models and get the value of beta coefficients. My c-hat value is pretty high (c-hat = 4.29) so it is showing an error "Error in AICc.unmarkedFit(X[[1L]], ...): High overdispersion and model fit is questionable". Though I just finished analysis from the same site with different species that had even higher c-hat value i.e. 10.26 (the beta estimates were horrible though :) ).

The code I used was 
AverageTrCov = modavg(modelList_forAveraging, "TrCov", 
                    modnames = modnames, second.ord = TRUE, 
                    nobs = NULL, uncond.se = "revised", 
                    conf.level = 0.95, exclude = NULL, 
                    warn = TRUE, c.hat = 4.29, 
                    parm.type = "psi")

AverageTrCov

where modelList_forAveraging is the list of all candidate models and I want to calculate the beta coefficient for Tree cover (TrCov)

Thank you and best,
Yadav

messages.author: cf90957368b0c5d2
messages.subject: RE:[unmarked] Error in AICc.unmarkedFit(X[[1L]], ...) :  High overdispersion and model fit is questionable
parts:
Hi Yadav,

With such high values of c-hat, you should look into model goodness of fit - this is why I programmed in the error in the function you are using. You could try mb.gof.test( ) to see what you get for your occupancy global model. If the model does not fit, you should consider adding in some variables or opting for some other type of model that fits better.

Best,

Marc
